facts.fact: NAWEC, the national water and electricity company, launched a mobile app on which customers can lodge complaints and report faults in real time with photos, though no complaint numbers are given.

GMB.note: No government payments to people stated.
No survey figure on account ownership.
Nothing on refugees or displaced people.
The app pays utility bills through APS Wallet, but the document does not say the wallet is a licensed mobile money service in service.
Utility bill payments to NAWEC are not taxes, duties or state fees.
